crossRefs.note: For the king knows of these things, to whom also I speak freely. For I am persuaded that none of these things is hidden…
crossRefs.keyword: let me. or, I may. freely

crossRefs.note: He gave him the covenant of circumcision. So Abraham became the father of Isaac, and circumcised him the eighth day.…
“The patriarchs, moved with jealousy against Joseph, sold him into Egypt. God was with him,
Now consider how great this man was, to whom even Abraham, the patriarch, gave a tenth out of the best plunder.
For David, after he had in his own generation served the counsel of God, fell asleep, was laid with his fathers, and…
David slept with his fathers, and was buried in David’s city.

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

translations.web: “Brothers, I may tell you freely of the patriarch David, that he both died and was buried, and his tomb is with us to this day.
translations.bsb: Brothers, I can tell you with confidence that the patriarch David died and was buried, and his tomb is with us to this day.
translations.kjv: Men and brethren, let me freely speak unto you of the patriarch David, that he is both dead and buried, and his sepulchre is with us unto this day.
translations.asv: Brethren, I may say unto you freely of the patriarch David, that he both died and was buried, and his tomb is with us unto this day.
